title: Remove the beads ids that the source-root landing put in code comments (3ced0fc, 507ac05)
outcome:
Greg's coding convention (bd memory code-comments-no-beads-ids, 2026-08-14): never put Beads ids in source comments, identifiers or user-facing copy. Comments must explain the invariant in self-contained language, and ids belong in Beads, commits and review notes only. The source-root landing broke this; Termal::Opus found it at handover, 2026-09-27.
Lines added in 0d54fd1..507ac05 (git diff 0d54fd1 507ac05 -- src ui, then grep for tm-), 12 lines in 10 files:
- src/delegation_mcp_source_root.rs: 3 (header 'tm-5gi4 phase 2' and 'tm-dy69'; doc of source_root_tool_definition)
- src/engram_source_roots.rs: 1 ('tm-5gi4 phase 2, Greg's option B')
- src/session_crud.rs: 1 (fence-gate comment '(tm-gcs8)')
- src/tests/acceptance_evaluation_source.rs, engram_control_transport.rs ('(tm-menr)'), engram_host_adapter.rs ('(tm-gcs8)'), engram_source_root_naming.rs, engram_source_roots.rs, engram_turn_observations.rs: 1 each
- ui/src/message-cards.tsx: 1 ('(tm-5gi4 phase 2)')
Fix: reword each comment to say what it means without the id, for example 'named source roots' in place of 'tm-5gi4 phase 2'. Comment-only change, so the normal gate and review pair apply. docs/features already cite beads ids, as elsewhere; leave them.
acceptance: No Beads id remains in the code comments, identifiers or user-facing strings the source-root landing (3ced0fc, 507ac05) added under src/ and ui/src/, and no line added under those directories from 0d54fd1 through the final source revision carries one, shown by an executor check cited in a note (Beads ids older than 0d54fd1 are outside this item)
